description: Add a product from just its URL: krawlup scrapes the site (name, tagline, description, icons) and adds it to the founder's dashboard. Every other field is optional — explicit values override the scrape. Adding NEVER publishes — the product is private until the founder (or set_product_public) publishes it. Requires the submit permission.

categories.description: Up to three category ids (or slugs/names) from check_launch_readiness. Optional — the founder can tag the product later.

description.description: Short description (max 600 characters). Omit to use the scraped description.

name.description: Product name (max 40 characters). Omit to use the scraped site title.

tagline.description: One-line tagline (max 120 characters). Omit to use the scraped site description.

twitterUsername.description: The product's X/Twitter handle (bare handle or profile URL)

name: add_product
